claims.text: Most reviewers say the balm makes stretching easier and less painful, often sliding in with little to no pain.
Many reviewers report it helps heal or fix problems like blowouts and scar tissue.
Several reviewers praise the value, noting a little goes a long way and it lasts a long time.
Some reviewers mention the pleasant smell or that it eliminates ear-stretching odor.
A few reviewers say it is not worth the price or no more soothing than cheaper ointments.

qa.q: Will this help with the smell from my stretched ears?
qa.answer: Yes, one reviewer says it takes away the "ear stretching smell" [2], and another notes the tea tree oil gives it a smell and properties to protect and soothe ears [3].

claims.text: It takes away the "ear stretching smell"
The tea tree oil gives it a smell and properties to protect and soothe ears

qa.q: Is it safe to use on a fresh piercing or only healed stretches?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: How long does the 10 ml jar last with daily use?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Does it absorb well or leave a greasy feeling?
qa.answer: Reviews say it is not greasy and absorbs well, with one noting it has fewer greasy oils than Holey Butt'r [2] and another saying they didn't find it greasy and a little goes a long way [1]. A third review notes some complaints about being too oily but suggests only a small amount is needed [3].

claims.text: It doesn't have the amount of greasy oils like in holey butt'r [2].
The reviewer didn't find the balm to be greasy and suspects if it is, you used too much since a little goes a long way [1].
Some complaints exist about being too oily, but only a small amount is needed [3].

qa.q: Is it good value compared to other ear stretching balms?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on value: one reviewer says it is not worth the price and that A&D ointment worked just as well for much less [1], while another says a tiny bit goes a long way and it is well worth the money [3].

claims.text: One reviewer says it is not worth the price and that A&D ointment worked just as well and is much more affordable.
Another reviewer says a tiny bit goes a long way and it is well worth the money.
